resolved_config.investigation_budget: one per player per game; only A has unknown preferences to query in these toys
resolved_config.query_observation: target/use public, exact answer private to A; answers persist
resolved_config.response_objective: own final utility, then other final utility
resolved_config.fixed_target_control: two players; fixed relevant pair; one final offer

adaptive_target_control.B_type: (b0,b1) uniform in {0,1}^2; B knows both bits
adaptive_target_control.logical_preferences: in each pair exactly one project is WANT (+1), the other AVOID (-1); no neutral types
adaptive_target_control.query_menu: any of four project preferences; complementary queries are equivalent and canonicalized to two bits
adaptive_target_control.public_event: independent fair R in {0,1}; only pair R is feasible after revelation
adaptive_target_control.timeline: optional early query -> public R -> optional late query if unused -> one offer or PASS -> B ACCEPT/REJECT -> terminal
adaptive_target_control.payoff: accepted project gives A=1, B=+1/-1 according to preference; REJECT/PASS=(0,0)
adaptive_target_control.response: B strictly accepts WANT, strictly rejects AVOID; no strategic continuation
adaptive_target_control.offers: one final offer, unchanged by query timing; no rejection penalty
adaptive_target_control.query_after_event_can_be_conditioned_on: public R only; never hidden B bits

resolved_config.prior_contract_control: original 3-contract/3-type/2-offer asymmetric toy, changing only query opportunity cost from one to zero; one query maximum
resolved_config.training_configuration: not applicable; no model, reward optimization, advantage, batching, validation or checkpoints

data_identity: synthetic full supports and exact priors specified in resolved_config; no external corpus/selection/D
sampling_reward_contract: exhaustive exact expectation; no Monte Carlo, GRPO, training reward or advantage
